contracts: (Independent NodeAuthorityTests native-launch and NodeSchedulingOwnerTests topology scenarios execute on an authorized isolated actual Windows host, existing Program and real registered low-privilege per-project Runners. Use temporary metadata/workspaces and synthetic protected-secret canaries only; collect actual owner/Runner identities, OS exclusion/access and process environment results with current implementation HEAD and exact-test current TRX. A separate competing service is rejected before ordinary scheduling. Linux/skips, no tests, new-type/build errors or binding failure cannot supply RED/GREEN; baseline existing-owner runtime missing guard/topology behavior may supply RED. GREEN requires actual authorized launch/result, denied invalid launches, filesystem/environment secret denial and physical-count evidence, not API presence. The plan grants no live-host mutation/deployment permission.) AND (NodeAuthorityTests execute real isolated Windows registered Runner/project probes against temporary protected central DB/config with synthetic canaries, checking denied read/mutation and unchanged central logical rows/digests plus valid project access. Actual OS identities/ACL/process context and no environment/context leak are required; no real credential values are printed. Linux stubs/marker-only/presence/build errors cannot supply Windows GREEN, and scope grants no live host mutation. Python selectors must use the native literal subprocess.run(["dotnet","test",test-project,"--filter","FullyQualifiedName=exact-FQN","--logger","trx"],shell=False) string argv and verify fresh exact selected-test TRX with actual behavior/data assertions. run_dotnet.py alone does not provide this AST binding. Static authoring checks do not close the known production-project fingerprint gap. If a retained behavior truly already passes, preserve actual unexpected-green rather than manufacture RED.) AND (NodePersistenceTests execute actual isolated Windows fixture with existing real Runner registrations, before/after protected metadata and OS registration identity/SID observations for all endpoint/port/instance cases. Each valid edit retains original IDs/bindings/registration and benign Runner usability. Exact C# current TRX binds through existing run_dotnet.py. Linux-only marker readback, missing new helper/build/binding errors, skipped tests or presence checks cannot supply required Windows GREEN; business RED is actual existing-owner identity/rebinding/registration defect. No live bind/Caddy/deployment or node-migration permission is inferred.)
